create_SiLKVGG: create a SiLKVGG model with VGG backbone for keypoint detection and descriptor extraction
create_SiLKLoFTR: create a SiLKLoFTR model with ResNet FPN backbone for multi-scale feature extraction
build_SiLKBase: build a SiLKBase model with a custom backbone and detector and descriptor heads

sparsify_descriptors: sparsify dense descriptors at detected keypoint positions with L2 normalization
